title: A|E as Symmetry-Referenced Mismatch Evaluation

basis.scope: Introduce a provisional metric bridge that reads A|E as symmetry-referenced mismatch evaluation under a shared reference coupling. The basis is additive and documentary, using the applied 047 asymmetry witness, the applied 049 carrier audit, and the applied 051 textbook provenance update while leaving RT_core unchanged.

core_candidate.reading: A|E is the evaluated mismatch Δ of A and E under a symmetry-reference coupling <S>, parameterized by residue-asymmetry r_a.

core_rule.statement: A|E is not ordinary pairwise distance between A and E; it is the evaluated asymmetry of A and E through a shared symmetry-reference coupling <S>.

constraints: <S> is not a midpoint between A and E.
<S> is the reference condition that makes mismatch evaluable.
A|E does not imply role symmetry.
r_a must not be conflated with R as relation or r as generic residue/history.

relationship_to_prior_patches.052: Begins metric bridge by making A|E evaluable as symmetry-referenced mismatch.
